meta.title: Human genome overview
meta.coordinates: Positions count letters from the start of each chromosome. startBp is inclusive and starts at 0; endBp is exclusive. A band's length is endBp minus startBp.
meta.geneDensity: geneDensity[i] is the number of protein-coding genes whose midpoint lies in the i-th block of 1,000,000 letters (block 0 is the first). The last block of each chromosome is shorter. The blocks of a chromosome add up to its proteinCodingGenes.
notes: The 24 chromosomes are 1 to 22, X and Y. The mitochondrial chromosome (16,569 letters, 13 protein-coding genes) is not on the map. GENCODE's published total of 19,411 protein-coding genes includes it.
18 genes lie in the two regions that X and Y share (the pseudoautosomal regions). They are listed on both X and Y, as GENCODE lists them.

Gene counts cover protein-coding genes only and leave out 654 readthrough records, as GENCODE's published counts do. GENCODE also lists tens of thousands of non-coding genes that are not counted here.

stains.stalk: Stalk (the thin short arm of chromosomes 13, 14, 15, 21 and 22)
